faqSection.title: Frequently asked questions
faqSection.description: Common questions about the demo call.

items.question: What happens on the call?
items.answer: We run your top products through the major AI shopping models while you watch, walk through why agents pick you or a competitor, and leave you with the highest-impact listing changes to make first.

items.question: How long does the demo take?
items.answer: Fifteen minutes. It is a focused working session, not a slide deck. If your team needs a deeper enterprise scoping call afterward, we will book that separately.

items.question: Do I need to prepare anything?
items.answer: Just the store URL or a few product links you care about. You do not need to connect your catalog or create an account before the call.

items.question: Can I skip the call and just start?
items.answer: Yes. The free Scan plan runs the same simulation on your top 10 products in about two minutes with no credit card. Book a call if you would rather have us walk through the results with you.
